AmbDescription:
Like to run with your dog? Interested in Canicross? Come join us for our montly meetup at the Confluence Nature Preserve in Hillsboro 

We have tester gear for humans/dogs of all sizes, and we welcome beginners who want to hike/do intervals/run!

This is a no-greet event for dogs, which means no-nose to nose greetings. This is a reactive dog friendly group, lets ensure everyone can enjoy!

This Park has several of loops for gaining miles or heading back to the car but the plan is to do the twin forks loop (1.9 miles with water access) and may add on the big meadow loop (1.3 miles)

Google Map link for parking: https://maps.app.goo.gl/q3GtMiDuTbQq43X26

Location Notes: Bring your own water for you/your dogs, there is a portable toilet on site. 

\*As a general rule, please respect all dogs' space during canicross. NO on-leash, nose to nose greetings. This is not an event for dogs to be social with others, please keep space between your dog and the dog in front of you when running and announce if you're going to be passing. This is a reactive dog friendly group.
